en.headline: Police arrest man after knife report at Kowloon Bay market
en.dek: Officers stopped a Route 1A bus near Choi Hung and seized a knife about 32 centimetres long from a 46-year-old man.
body: Police arrested a 46-year-old man on Wednesday afternoon after a report that a man was carrying a knife at Kai Yip Market in Kowloon Bay. Officers said they received the call at 1:06pm and that the man had already left by the time they arrived.

Emergency unit officers from Kowloon East and Kowloon West reviewed closed-circuit television, including footage under the SmartView scheme, and found the man had boarded a Kowloon Motor Bus Route 1A vehicle in Mong Kok heading towards East Kowloon. The two regions stopped the bus on Prince Edward Road East near Choi Hung Estate.

Police said a knife about 32 centimetres long was found in a sling bag the man was carrying. He was arrested on suspicion of possession of an offensive weapon and was being detained. The case was passed to the fourth team of the Sau Mau Ping district crime squad. He has not been charged.

zh.headline: 啟業街市持刀報案 警方彩虹截巴士拘捕男子
zh.dek: 人員在太子道東近彩虹邨截停1A巴士，在一名46歲男子的斜孭袋內檢獲約32厘米長刀。
body: 九龍灣啟業邨啟業街市星期三下午有人報稱一名男子持刀遊蕩。警方表示，下午1時06分接報，人員到場時該名男子已經離開。
東九龍及西九龍總區衝鋒隊翻查閉路電視，包括銳眼計劃片段，發現他在旺角登上往東九龍方向的九巴1A線。兩區人員其後在太子道東近彩虹邨對開截停該輛巴士。
警方稱，在該名46歲男子的斜孭袋內檢獲一把約32厘米長的刀。他涉嫌藏有攻擊性武器被捕，現正被扣留。案件交秀茂坪警區刑事調查隊第四隊跟進。他尚未被落案起訴。
